acip: MA KHYAB NA, KHYAB PA YOD PAR THAL, DKAR PO DANG DMAR PO GNYIS KYI GZHI MTHUN MED PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: ma khyab na, khyab pa yod par thal, dkar po dang dmar po gnyis kyi gzhi mthun med pa'i phyir
english: Just because something's white, doesn't mean it can't be red! Suppose you say that it's not necessarily the case.  And yet it is necessarily so, because it is impossible for one thing to be entirely white and entirely red, at the same time.
